name: What!? My Neighbors Are Demons!!?
source:
Uh oh! It seems our protagonist was a bit too rough with her ex-boyfriend following high school. After being incapable of putting up with Selene’s insatiable lust, Selene’s Ex broke off their relationship. Traumatized from being dumped, Selene has chosen to keep the overtly lustful side of her personality locked away.

Now in college and living on her own, she has been mostly successful in this endeavor despite a few strange friendships and some lonely nights.Things quickly change, however, as the woman’s somewhat calm and solitary life get turned upside down. Twin demons (a succubus and an incubus), secretly parading as humans, have suddenly moved in next door to her.

Once the two mischievous and sultry twins find out that their “dear neighbor” is having a bit of a crisis, the demons decided to take on the task to “fix” her. Regardless of the consequences…

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/657580/What_My_Neighbors_Are_Demons/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
糟糕！我们的主人公在高中毕业后对前男友下手太狠了。塞勒涅无法忍受自己无穷无尽的欲望，前男友因此与她分手。遭到抛弃的创伤让塞勒涅决定把自己放荡的一面封锁起来。

如今她上了大学，独自生活。尽管结交了几段奇怪的友谊，也度过了一些孤独的夜晚，但她大体上成功做到了这一点。然而，事情很快发生变化：这个女人原本平静而孤独的生活被彻底颠覆。两个秘密伪装成人类的双胞胎恶魔——魅魔与梦魔——突然搬到了她隔壁。

这对淘气又妖艳的双胞胎发现“亲爱的邻居”正经历危机后，决定承担起“修复”她的任务。无论后果如何……

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/657580/What_My_Neighbors_Are_Demons/]Steam[/url]]
